text.tspan: Drift detection: a scheduled plan that fails loudly
Change is NOT wanted → revert it
Prevent: read-only console roles / SCPs, all changes via MR + pipeline, ignore_changes only for fields
owned by something else (EKS node group desired_size owned by Cluster Autoscaler). plan can't see resources that were never in state.
